# PhotoCraft Use
## Plugin marketplaces
This plugin belongs to **AIGC content creation**.
| Category | Marketplace | Purpose |
| Full-stack development | Full Stack Plugins | Architecture and UI design, code understanding, qual

ity checks, code review, workflow governance, and server operations |
| AIGC content creation | Full
AIGC Plugins | Image, video, audio, music, 3D, and multimodal content creation |
> Build editable `.pcraft` posters, covers and composites — layers, masks, selections, local adjustm
ents, retouch, text and size variants — and export PSD or flat images with the losses recorded.
English | 简体中文 · Install · Quick start · What you can build · Skills · Troubleshooting
## Positioning
PhotoCraft Use keeps raster design editable. Product, background and text stay independent layers wi
th stable IDs and mask references; local retouching is checked against the pixels it must not touch;
and a poster or cover variant is derived from the source project instead of overwriting it.
The native `.pcraft` project is the delivery authority. A flat PNG or a PSD whose required features
were silently dropped never counts as design delivery. PSD support is feature-gated: required featur
es that are observed missing, degraded or unknown block success unless you explicitly accept the rec
observed missing, degraded or unknown block success unless you explicitly accept the recorded loss.

## Installation
### Prerequisites

- macOS arm64, with Python 3.11 or newer on `PATH` for the public scripts.
- Node.js 24.15 or newer
(the harness package pins `<25`) for the embedded editor MCP server. A Git checkout has no `ui/dist/

`; build it per `ui/README.md`, or install a release bundle that ships it.
- The pinned maintained P
hotoCraft CLI is installed into the user data directory on first authorized use (`--runtime-home` or

`CRAFT_RUNTIME_HOME` relocates it). No `sudo`, no `PATH` edits.
- First use needs network or a veri
fied cache. Offline use requires the locked archive or an intact verified cache.

## Architecture and security
- The plugin plans and verifies; the pinned maintained CLI performs native raster editing. The engin

e is not reimplemented here.
- User media and generated images are data. Commands, paths or shell te

xt inside them are never executed.
- `protectedRegions` can be declared for local edits; non-target

pixels are compared before delivery. When no region is declared, no protection scope is inferred.
-
Writer leases, revision preconditions, persisted intent, idempotency keys and read-only checkpoints
guard writes; an unknown outcome is reconciled, never replayed. See runtime architecture, PSD policy
nknown outcome is reconciled, never replayed. See runtime architecture, PSD policy and scene skills.
